metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (CAR_CLAMS_BRDF 2): a self-relation, which should be removed.
No lineage associations; this run proposes RELATED CAR_CLAMS_L1C (parallel_product, MEDIUM), RELATED CLAMS_CV580_CAR (related_to, LOW).
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-lprm-amsr2-soilm2-001) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
Granule names carry the campaign year 2004; the campaign was in 2001.

excluded.detail: Implied by "Version 2 represents the best available CAR BRDF data product" (BRDF README §1.4).
Upstream of the post-processing (provider data levels); not CMR collections, except CLAMS_CV580_CAR (LaRC, written as related_to).
Same instrument, README and format, other campaigns; no data dependency (template_of at most).
